notes: ACCESS: plain curl_cffi, HTTP 200 on every request, no WAF, no proxy. ROBOTS: https://www.the-citizenry.com/robots.txt fetched FIRST and read in full (3,642 bytes). It contains exactly two user-agent groups, 'User-agent: *' and 'User-agent: adsbot-google'. There is NO group naming ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai or Claude-Web anywhere in the file, and no Content-Signal line. The generic group opens with 'User-agent: * / Allow: /' and only disallows /admin, /cart/, /checkout, /orders, /account, /services, /sf_*, /cart.js, /recommendations/products and sort_by / filter / preview crawl-trap query forms. Every /collections/ path used below is explicitly allowed; no Crawl-delay is declared (probe.py still paced 2s/host). The header comments only restrict automated CHECKOUT/payment, which this run does not do. TREE: the mega-menu is a Vue component (#vue-desktop-nav) with no server-rendered anchors - a fetch of the homepage returns zero occurrences of the string 'bath'. The tree was therefore taken from the site's own headless CMS, GET https://cdn.builder.io/api/v3/content/nav?apiKey=ffd771d56cde49a3932ba2dc845afab8, which returns 20 published nav variants; the live one is 'Default Nav 2026' (lastUpdated 1787609628594 = 2026-08-24 22:13:48 UTC, the newest published entry). This is the same source the Furniture pass on this company used and cross-checked against a Chrome render. Its BATH department has exactly five entries and no deeper level: Shop All (/collections/shop-all-bath), Bath Towels & Sets (/collections/bath-all-towels), Bath Mats & Rugs (/collections/all-bath-mats), Bath Furniture (/collections/all-bath-furniture), Bath Accessories (/collections/bath-accessories), plus a 'Towels 101' editorial link to /pages/towel-guide. 'Shop All' is dropped under rule 25. Depth was confirmed rather than assumed: each of the five collection pages was fetched and its server-rendered HTML contains no subcategory anchors at all (the only /collections/ hrefs on /all-bath-mats are itself, bath-all-towels, shop-all-bath, /shop and /gift-cards), so the Bath tree is genuinely flat. QTY: the PLPs are client-rendered (all five return a valid canonical and a correct <meta description> but zero /products/ hrefs and no h1 in the server HTML). The grid is driven by SearchSpring - the page loads https://snapui.searchspring.io/g4yph2/bundle.js with template 'collection.combo' - so the count was taken from the storefront's OWN engine: GET https://g4yph2.a.searchspring.io/api/search/search.json?siteId=g4yph2&resultsFormat=native&resultsPerPage=100&bgfilter.collection_handle=<handle>, field pagination.totalResults. Bath Accessories = 10 (pagination.totalResults 10, begin 1 end 10, totalPages 1, and exactly 10 result objects returned, enumerated below). VERIFICATION: the SearchSpring total was independently cross-checked against Shopify's own collection product API, /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 (paged to exhaustion, unique handles counted), on all five bath collections and on four of the five the two sources agree EXACTLY at four different sizes - shop-all-bath 13/13, bath-all-towels 9/9, all-bath-mats 5/5, all-bath-furniture 8/8. The single divergence is Bath Accessories, SearchSpring 10 vs products.json 11, and it was run to ground rather than averaged: the extra handle is riya-marble-wastebasket, and /products/riya-marble-wastebasket.js returns available:false with its only variant ('Natural') also available:false, i.e. it is sold out and dropped from the SearchSpring index, so the rendered PLP shows 10 tiles. 10 is therefore the page's real count, not an estimate. The five totals differ per category (13/10/9/8/5), so this is not a site-wide constant. The rendered 'N Products' header was NOT used as a source: the Furniture pass on this same company proved with examples that this theme's header counts merchandised TILES (colourway splits and injected promo banners), not products; SearchSpring totalResults is per-product and each of the 10 accessories returns as a single result despite Terranova Vase having 3 variants and Beeswax Tapers 6. CONTENT OF THE ONE LEAF (all 10 enumerated from the API): Riya Marble Tissue Box, Riya Marble Toothbrush Holder, Riya Marble Soap Dispenser, Riya Marble Bath Accessory Set, Riya Marble Canister, Riya Marble Soap Dish, Hinoki Wood Soap Dish (7 = soap/toothbrush/canister/tissue accessories, rules 13 and 18), plus Tikal Wood Bud Vase, Terranova Vase and Beeswax Taper Candles Set of 2. DEDUP: dedup.already_extracted() was called on all five candidate URLs. One hit - /collections/all-bath-furniture is already in Furniture.xlsx for this same company as sub-category 'Bath'. Per dispatch_note.md OPTION 1 it is recorded in `review` only. The other four returned None. EXCLUDED: /collections/shop-all-bath (Shop All, rule 25). The collections sitemap (sitemap_collections_1.xml, 1,143 URLs) was swept for bath/mirror/soap/towel/vanity/shower/toilet/accessory slugs and returns ~60 further bath-related handles - e.g. bathroom-essentials, the-moroccan-bath-collection, the-spa-edit-bath-essentials, marble-bath-accessories, bath-wood-bath-mats, bath-bath-mat-rugs, style-edit-the-organic-modern-bathroom, mothers-day-gift-guide-bath, the-spring-event-bath, wedding-gift-guide-bath, bath-kitchen-before-they-go, guest-room-essentials-bath. NONE of these appears in the live nav; they are merchandising/campaign/seasonal/A-B-test collections and are excluded under rules 23 and 25 (navigation is the authority, not URL pattern guessing). /collections/all-mirrors and /collections/shop-all-decor-accents-mirrors sit under the DECOR department, not Bath, and hold general decor mirrors, so they are Decor and not re-extracted here; the only mirrors the site itself files under Bath (Hinoki Wood Wall Mirror and Floor Mirror) are inside /collections/all-bath-furniture, which is the already-extracted node above.
